scope: Each external Maven component has exactly one raw evidence annotation and exactly one derived primary grade.
primaryRule: Primary grade is a total function of the component raw state. Direct/transitive relationship is independent and must never decide license evidence grade.

rawStateDescriptions.DIRECT_POM_EXACT: S4-A direct artifact had a parsed POM license.
rawStateDescriptions.LOCAL_POM_EXACT: This review parsed the exact local POM for the component.
rawStateDescriptions.EXACT_POM_CHECKED: S4-A family row explicitly records exact POM checking for this evidence class.
rawStateDescriptions.HIGH_FAMILY_MAPPING: License comes from a high-confidence coordinate-family mapping, not per-artifact POM extraction.
rawStateDescriptions.FAMILY_EXCEPTION_POM_LICENSE_MISSING: The cached POM lacks a licenses element; family/NOTICE evidence remains non-exact.
rawStateDescriptions.FAMILY_WITH_EXPLICIT_NAME_EXCEPTION: The family mapping needs an explicit non-SPDX license name; it is not promoted to exact evidence.
rawStateDescriptions.MIXED_EXACT_AND_FAMILY: The source evidence class mixes exact and family evidence and must remain visibly mixed.
